verdict.rationale: Snyk IaC explicitly documents scanning Terraform, Kubernetes, CloudFormation, and ARM for misconfigurations, plus drift detection and integration into IDE/SCM/CLI/Terraform Cloud workflows. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of IaC-specific scanning (probe evidence only covers OSS/code scanning, not IaC test runs) and no community commentary specifically validating IaC scan quality.
